summary.content:
Today's selection covers 86 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 65 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI boss says world 'right to be afraid' but 'should trust' AI firms
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Black Hat USA 2026 | The 'Breaking' News: The OpenAI–Hugging Face Incident
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 53 articles published in the last 24 hours
